Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 9  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Divorce Invitation was released earlier than Xenoa. The Planner cited Xenoa's release date as August 22, 2017, instead of the correct date of August 22, 2007. This error in interpreting the release year led to the incorrect conclusion that Divorce Invitation (released in 2012) came out earlier than Xenoa. The Planner overlooked the correct information provided earlier that Xenoa was released in 2007, which was clearly indicated in the WebSurfer's findings.
